boundary_audit.reading: The boundary is a property of the UNTREATED course (the shared haemorrhage takes the effective output to zero at minute 349 in both cases) and is reached by no scripted scenario of the matrix, by the late rescue (order at 215, played to 336) or by any treated course. In an UNBOUNDED window it is reachable, so the verdict is not A. The window can be bounded by the experiment's own script, with 109 minutes of margin, and an authority transaction that meets it would abort on `no_unresolved_boundary` and halt visibly: an experiment stop, not a terminal rule. A runtime terminal mapping stays required before any unbounded or resident-facing authority; none is invented here.

checkpoint.reading: Ready for the faculty's REVIEW of the experiment's design. It is not an authority grant and not a readiness to activate: the blockers above stand.

design.name: GI_PRESSURE_PLUS_CONSCIOUSNESS_DEVELOPMENT_AUTHORITY_EXPERIMENT (DESIGN ONLY)
design.no_mixed_trajectory: the pair is written in one transaction or not at all; a minute is never half common, half legacy; after the first commit the encounter never returns to the legacy engine

domain: mental_status (the legacy word of the common category)
scope.window: scripted scenarios of at most 240 simulated minutes (109 minutes before the boundary); the experiment ends there by its own script, the encounter is never terminated by the common core

bound_by: every value equal to the record
snapshot_binding.no_implicit_defaults: the Amendment-2 profile is built from the record, never from the names in `systemic_consciousness.WITNESSES`; a missing or different value refuses

stages: 0. re-run the pressure authority series on the active lineage member (no physiology)
1. technical readiness: a categorical writer with a pairing rule, the snapshot binding, the audit of the consumers of mental status, the layer able to run the snapshot by id and digest
2. dry run: the full capture, compute and validate steps for the pair on the 14 scenarios, WITHOUT commit (this cycle's counterfactual harness is its first form)
3. only with a written faculty grant: the first development commit, bounded as above
transaction: capture the authoritative state (copy, nothing written)
compute: the common candidate of the minute from the shadow, beside the legacy counterfactual
validate: the existing ten checks plus snapshot_bound, pair_complete, consumers_declared, window_open
commit ONCE, from one prepared mapping, to a copy the caller owns, with the gate re-evaluated at commit; or abort with a rollback artifact
